note: Maps Samgongustofa Orkugjafi labels to drivetrain groups. Labels were DISCOVERED from the live report, not assumed: the real forms use a slash and an abbreviation (Bensin /Raf.tengill), not the spaced forms in the original brief. The commercially load-bearing distinction is PLUGIN vs not — Bensin /Rafmagn is a self-charging hybrid that never plugs in, so grouping it with PHEV would inflate every addressable-market figure. Velarlaus means engineless: those rows are trailers, not vehicles, and are excluded from motorised totals.

groups.BEV: Battery electric — plugs in, no combustion engine
groups.PHEV: Plug-in hybrid — plugs in, also has a combustion engine
groups.HYBRID_NON_PLUGIN: Self-charging hybrid — does NOT plug in, is not addressable charging demand
groups.OTHER: Known but outside the four groups (hydrogen, methane, and similar)
groups.UNKNOWN: Label not present in this map. Counted, reported, never guessed.
groups.NON_MOTORISED: Engineless (Velarlaus) — trailers and similar. Not a vehicle for market sizing.

formulas.plugin_share_note: HYBRID_NON_PLUGIN, OTHER and UNKNOWN are excluded from BOTH numerator and denominator by default. Including non-plug hybrids in the denominator would understate plug-in share; including them in the numerator would overstate addressable charging demand. Either is a real error, so neither is the default.
formulas.unknown_handling: UNKNOWN is excluded from the denominator unless includeUnknownInDenominator is set. A share computed over an unknown-heavy month is reported with its unknown count so the reader can judge it.
